info.name: Sadq Integration Archiving & Delegations Envelopes API

params.name: FileId
params.description: Optional. Custom file identifier (Guid). If omitted, the system generates one.

params.name: WebhookId
params.description: Optional. Target a specific webhook instead of the tenant default.

params.name: WorkflowId
params.description: Optional. Attach the envelope to an existing workflow.

params.name: ReferenceNumber
params.description: Optional. Your own reference number. If omitted, the system generates one.

params.name: Password
params.description: Optional. Password to protect the uploaded PDF.

items.docs: Initiate a signature envelope by uploading document files as multipart/form-data. Returns an envelope and Docuemnt ID that can be used in subsequent signing invitation steps.
Initiate a signature envelope by providing the document content as a Base64-encoded string. The system creates an envelope and returns its ID for subsequent signing invitation steps.
Initiate a signature envelope using a predefined template. The template defines the document structure, signing fields, and signer roles. Returns an envelope ID.
Initiate multiple signature envelopes in a single request by providing documents as Base64-encoded strings. Returns an array of envelope IDs.

params.name: envelopeId
params.description: The unique identifier of the envelope

items.docs: Download all files associated with an envelope. Returns file content as binary or base64 depending on the Accept header.

params.name: envelopeId
params.description: The unique identifier of the envelope to cancel

items.docs: Cancel an active envelope, preventing any further signing actions. Cancellation is irreversible. All pending signers will be notified.

params.name: envelopeId
params.description: The unique identifier of the envelope

items.docs: Retrieve the current status of an envelope including signer completion details and overall progress.

params.name: envelopeId
params.description: The unique identifier of the completed envelope

items.docs: Download the signed and completed files from an envelope. Only available after all signers have completed signing.

The API provides a complete end-to-end digital document signing workflow in a single operation. It initiates a signature envelope by accepting the document content as a Base64-encoded string, and immediately creates the envelope while generating a unique envelope ID.
